## What State 17 does

State 17 Consulting is a boutique venture architecture firm founded by Jim Pushor. It helps owners and investors decide where to commit time and capital. Each engagement assesses the business, its market and resources to choose a course, plan the work and test the key assumption. Engagements have a fixed scope, a fixed fee and a clear handover. The firm works with start-ups, turnarounds, new ventures and established industries. It does not provide open-ended implementation or fractional executive roles.

A venture architect assesses a business opportunity across product, operations, finance and technology, then develops a practical plan for the people, capital and work needed to pursue it.

## Who State 17 works with

- Start-ups: test the technical and commercial assumptions before seeking investment.
- Turnarounds: trace how product complexity affects purchasing, production and cost.
- New ventures: assess the revenue drivers and risks of an acquisition, expansion or new business.
- Established industries: make engineering records easier to find, verify and use.

## Services

Every engagement has a fixed scope, a fixed fee and a clear end. Fees are quoted after a free twenty-minute introductory call.

1. Decision Sprint. Assess the evidence and key assumptions. A clear recommendation: proceed, stop or wait. Two to three weeks. Fixed fee, quoted after an introductory call.

2. Venture Blueprint. A practical plan covering costs, people, tools, capital, risks and the order of work. Three to five weeks. Fixed fee, quoted after an introductory call.

3. Proof Sprint. A prototype, pilot or model that tests the key assumption against agreed criteria. Three to six weeks. Fixed fee, quoted after an introductory call.

Decision Review: for past clients. A quarterly review of the next major decision, informed by current business results. Fixed annual fee.

## What State 17 does not do

No open-ended implementation, fractional executive roles or ongoing software maintenance. Each new problem is a separate engagement.

## How to get in touch

Request an introductory call at https://state17consulting.com/#contact or email jim@state17consulting.com. A free twenty-minute call to discuss the decision and whether Jim can help.
